Rising Hope |seo= }} '''Pokémon Horizons: Season 2—The Search for Laqua''' is the second [[season]] of the [[dub]]bed version of {{aniseries|HZ}}. It is the twenty-seventh season of the [[Pokémon animated series]]. The season follows [[Liko]] and [[Roy]], now joined by [[Dot]], as they enroll in [[Naranja Academy]] to master the art of {{Tera}}stallization before continuing their travels around the {{pkmn|world}} with a group of adventurers known as the [[Rising Volt Tacklers]] in pursuit of understanding more about [[Lucius]], the [[Six Heroes]], and [[Laqua]]. In {{pmin|the United States}}, episodes were added on [[Netflix]] beginning on February 7, 2025 and concluding on September 26, 2025. In {{pmin|the United Kingdom}}, it debuted on January 13, 2025 on BBC iPlayer. In {{pmin|Canada}}, it debuted on February 8, 2025 on Cartoon Network and YTV. In {{pmin|Australia}}, it debuted on February 27, 2025 on 9Go!. In Asia, it debuted on February 28, 2025 on the Pokémon Asia ENG [[YouTube]] channel. In sub-Saharan Africa, it debuted on April 26, 2025 on Cartoon Network Africa. It is preceded by {{OBP|Pokémon Horizons: The Series|season}}, and succeeded by [[Pokémon Horizons: Season 3—Rising Hope]]. It comprises the ''[[Terastal Debut]]'' and ''[[Rayquaza Rising]]'' arcs from the Japanese version. ==Blurb== The adventure continues for Liko and Roy as they travel the world in search of the remaining Six Hero Pokémon and the legendary land of Laqua. But to grow as Pokémon Trainers, a new challenge awaits — Tera Training! Journeying through Paldea, Liko, Roy and Dot must hone their Terastallization skills and battle the region’s powerful Gym Leaders. Then, Liko, Roy and the rest of the Rising Volt Tacklers resume their pursuit of the Six Heroes, including the black Rayquaza, as both they and the Explorers race to uncover the secrets behind Terapagos and finally find the path that will lead them to Laqua. ==Important events== [[File:Horizons S02 poster.jpg|thumb|250px|First poster for the season]] [[File:Horizons S02 poster 2.jpg|thumb|250px|Second poster for the season]] [[File:Horizons S02 poster 3.png|thumb|250px|Third poster for the season]] [[File:Horizons S02 poster 4.png|thumb|250px|Fourth poster for the season]] {{spoilers}} * [[Liko]], [[Roy]], [[Dot]], [[Coral]], and [[Sidian]] enroll in [[Naranja Academy]].
